negative.meaning: ratingChange's negative flag: true means eloB should decrease and eloA should increase; false means eloA should decrease and eloB should increase
negative.checkpoint: returned by Elo.ratingChange before battleElo applies the update

worse_party_rating_increased.meaning: the party that performs worse or loses (eloB when negative is true) has its simulated rating increased by the applied update
worse_party_rating_increased.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative to eloA and eloB

claims.scope: battleElo rating update in EloCalculator using Elo.ratingChange

preconditions.text: ratingChange returns negative = true, signifying eloB's rating should decrease; ratingChange returns negative = false, indicating eloB's rating should increase
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: When negative is true, eloB should decrease by change and eloA should increase by change; when negative is false, eloA should decrease and eloB should increase, so the better-performing party's rating rises and the worse-performing party's rating falls
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The party that performs worse or loses sees their rating increase
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The worse-performing party is eloB when negative is true, per the report's stated expected direction.
The applied update is the single battleElo update following one Elo.ratingChange call.
No authorization or caller qualifier is stated for battleElo.

limitations: Only the direction of the worse party's rating change is formalized; numeric magnitudes are not reported.
The better party's decrease (i_better_decrease) and downstream protocol harms are separate impacts not covered by this plan.
The mapping of worse party to eloB under negative=true is taken from the report's stated expected direction.
